title: Bring your transport
text: You supply the upload function; fetch, XHR, or chunked uploads all fit.

title: Progress per file
text: Each item shows its progress, status, and size as it uploads.

title: Cancel and retry
text: Cancellation aborts the transfer through a signal; failed items can be retried.

title: Concurrency and retries
text: Limit parallel uploads and retry failures automatically with a delay.

title: Image previews
text: Optional previews for image files while they upload.
